parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the front door of the microwave, made of tempered glass and framed with plastic or metal for durability.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cooking chamber and provides visibility of the food while heating.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or swings open on a hinge to allow insertion and removal of food.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the control panel and buttons, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to set cooking time, power level, and other functions of the microwave.
parts.Movement_description: The buttons or dials can be pressed or rotated to input commands.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame forms the structural skeleton of the microwave, made of steel for rigidity and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components and maintains the overall shape and strength of the appliance.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides structural integrity.

parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: This is the inner cavity of the microwave where food is placed, made of stainless steel for easy cleaning and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It reflects microwaves evenly to cook food and withstands high temperatures.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part, though it may contain a rotating glass plate inside.
